bullets.id: Emas spot ditutup naik 1,59% di $4.171 pada Kamis, menghapus penurunan Rabu ketika CPI September yang lebih panas (3,7% yoy, inti +0,3% mom) menekan kontrak Desember sekitar $69 ke $4.107,90. PPI September melonjak 1,3% mom dan 6,3% yoy, jauh di atas perkiraan 5,5%, terutama karena energi. Aksi jual saham global, termasuk Kospi −7,6% dan Nikkei −4,9%, mendorong permintaan aset aman.
bullets.en: Spot gold settled up 1.59% at $4,171 on Thursday, erasing Wednesday’s drop, when a hotter September CPI (3.7% y/y, core +0.3% m/m) pushed December futures down about $69 to $4,107.90. September PPI jumped 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y, far above the 5.5% forecast, driven mostly by energy. A global equity selloff, including Kospi −7.6% and Nikkei −4.9%, lifted safe-haven demand.

bullets.id: Yield 10 tahun turun ke sekitar 5,08%, terendah dalam sekitar tiga pekan, dan indeks dolar mundur ke sekitar 102,1 dari puncak 18 bulan pada Rabu, sementara Brent bertahan di sekitar $104. Pasar memberi peluang sekitar 29–32% kenaikan suku bunga pada rapat FOMC 27–28 Oktober dan sekitar 90% hingga Desember. Emas turun sekitar 4% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The 10-year yield fell to about 5.08%, its lowest in about three weeks, and the dollar index eased to about 102.1 from Wednesday’s 18-month high, while Brent held near $104. Markets price about a 29–32% chance of a rate hike at the October 27–28 FOMC meeting and about 90% by December. Gold is down about 4% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Kitco menandai resistance di $4.181, lalu $4.217 dan $4.267; analisis lain menyebut zona $4.199–$4.226. Support di $4.128 dan $4.107, lalu $4.088, dengan zona yang lebih dalam di $4.000–$4.075. Jumat ini pasar menyimak pidato Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh dan data produksi industri AS September.
bullets.en: Kitco marks resistance at $4,181, then $4,217 and $4,267; other analysis cites a $4,199–$4,226 zone. Support sits at $4,128 and $4,107, then $4,088, with a deeper $4,000–$4,075 zone. On Friday the market watches a speech by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and US September industrial production data.

bullets.id: Antam naik Rp4.000 ke Rp2.565.000/gram setelah turun Rp13.000 pada Kamis; buyback naik Rp5.000 ke Rp2.375.000, spread Rp190.000 (sekitar 7,4%). Galeri24 Rp2.509.000 (buyback Rp2.362.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS Rp2.533.000 (buyback Rp2.337.000, spread sekitar 7,7%).
bullets.en: Antam rose Rp4,000 to Rp2,565,000/gram after a Rp13,000 drop on Thursday; buyback rose Rp5,000 to Rp2,375,000, a Rp190,000 spread (about 7.4%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,509,000 (buyback Rp2,362,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS at Rp2,533,000 (buyback Rp2,337,000, spread about 7.7%).
